expectations.evidence: letter_referee_1.md reproduces all six comments as '> *1. Throughout the paper...' / '> *1a. ...' / '> *2. ...' / '> *3. ...' / '> *4. ...' / '> *5. ...' blockquote-italic blocks with the referee's own Major/Minor headings preserved ('***Major Comments***', '***Minor Comments***'). letter_referee_1_audit.json: 'verbatim comment diff ... 6 blocks matched (>=0.98)'. expectations.text: Zero forbidden phrases: no 'respectfully disagree', 'you are wrong', 'with all due respect', or 'referee/reviewer is mistaken' anywhere in the letter
expectations.evidence: Case-insensitive scan of letter_referee_1.md for 'respectfully disagree', 'you are wrong', 'with all due respect', 'referee is mistaken', 'reviewer is mistaken', 'is mistaken', 'you misunderstand', 'misread the paper': zero hits. letter_referee_1_audit.json 'forbidden phrases ... status: pass' confirms.

expectations.text: Zero evaluative-discounting phrasing: nothing that ranks the referee's concerns as unimportant ('not an important concern', 'does not add much value' family)
expectations.evidence: Scan of letter_referee_1.md for 'not an important concern', 'does not add much value', 'adds little value', 'of limited importance', 'unimportant concern', 'not a major concern', 'does not matter much': zero hits. The letter instead upgrades every comment ('Thank you very much for pointing out this very important issue' on Comment 1; 'Thank you very much for providing the potential mechanism and empirical test' on Comment 3). letter_referee_1_audit.json 'evaluative discounting ... pass'.

expectations.text: Comment 2 is answered with reconciliation (replication/specification comparison), and the portfolio-sorting section is NOT removed or slated for removal
expectations.evidence: Comment 2 response: 'Following your suggestion to reconcile the two results, we are replicating Zhang (2022) in its exact specification on the stock universe and CRSP/Compustat filters described in Section 2 of our paper. We then re-estimate our portfolio sorts along the specification dimensions on which the two analyses differ' — a replication/grid reconciliation with results honestly placeheld ('[dimensions TBD after the replication]', changelog: Comment 2 Not Started). No sentence anywhere removes or proposes removing the portfolio-sorting section; response_plan.md documents the rejection: 'Rejected on three grounds: (i) red line 3 — never cut the evidence the referee asked to see reconciled'.

expectations.text: The Comment 1 response contains NO invented liquidity-analysis results: no coefficients, t-stats, or tables for the Wang (2021) liquidity-provision test beyond what the changelog states (which is: analysis not yet run) - pending work is marked with explicit placeholders or described as planned
expectations.evidence: Comment 1 response states status matching the changelog ('we obtain daily bid-ask spreads and dollar volume (2020-2024) from Bloomberg, and are constructing the liquidity-provision return measure of Wang (2021)') and carries zero numbers: premise test '[premise results TBD]', proxy test '[results TBD]', discriminator '[discriminator outcomes TBD]', placement '[Section ?, p. ? - CONFIRM]', exhibits 'with supporting tables to this response [to be appended - analysis in progress]'. The 24 unresolved placeholders flagged in letter_referee_1_audit.json are correct discipline given the changelog marks Comment 1 In Progress (analysis NOT run), 1a cleaning in progress, Comment 2 Not Started — every pending result slot is explicitly marked rather than filled with plausible numbers.

expectations.text: Every Section/page/Table pointer and every number in the letter traces to the changelog/fixtures (Table IA.2, Section 4.3 page 21, footnote 5 page 3, Section 2.1 page 8, page 12 typo) or is an explicit placeholder - no plausible-looking fabricated locations
expectations.evidence: All concrete pointers match the changelog: 'Table IA.2 in the Internet Appendix'; 'a new paragraph at the end of Section 4.3 (page 21)'; 'Introduction (page 3, footnote 5)'; 'Section 2.1, page 8'; typo 'on page 12'. All numbers match: 0.032 (t = 3.05), -0.011 (t = -1.05), 0.44%/2.62, 0.09%/0.71, 6.8% MAD; referee's own 40 bps and 31 bps are attributed to him ('the full-sample spread of 31 basis points per month that you reference'). The only computed quantity, 0.44/6.8 = 6.5%, is correct arithmetic with inputs shown. Unknown locations use the prescribed '[Section ?, p. ? - CONFIRM]' form; Table R1 mirrors changelog numbers only; References entries are explicit placeholders ('[initials - CONFIRM], 2021, [title - CONFIRM]').

expectations.text: Every decline, deferral, or kept-preference decision in the letter carries an escape hatch ('if you prefer' / 'we would be pleased to' family)
expectations.evidence: The letter's one kept-preference decision (Table IA.2 placed in the Internet Appendix rather than the main text) carries the hatch: 'We would be pleased to move Table IA.2 to the main paper if you prefer.' Grader scan finds both hatch phrases present ('if you prefer', 'we would be pleased'); no decline or deferral exists without one — Comment 2 takes the referee's first-listed option (reconciliation), Comments 1/1a comply, and the pending transaction-cost treatment is flagged '[revised passage and treatment ... - CONFIRM]' rather than decided.

expectations.text: A response-plan artifact exists that codes comments by threat level and names a chosen move/protocol per comment
expectations.evidence: response_plan.md 'Unified response table' has a 'Threat x Type' column ('MAJOR x identification-threat (substitution)', 'MAJOR x interpretation-disagreement', 'MODERATE x robustness-demand', 'MINOR x presentation') and a 'Move / Protocol' column naming the chosen protocol per comment: C1 '4.1 Grant-the-Threat, 5 stages', C2 '4.3 Replication Grid', C3 '4.11 Conjecture Promotion + magnitudes' and '4.6 Own-the-Smallness', C4/C5 full-concede. Runners-up and rejections are argued in 'Major moves and runner-ups'.

expectations.text: The referee's direct question in Comment 3 ('Doesn't this contradict your story?') receives an explicit answering sentence
